question: Which Indian state was the highest contributor to Food Corporation of India (FCI)’s total paddy procurement across the country till May 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Telangana was the highest contributor to the Food Corporation of India (FCI)’s total paddy procurement across the country till May 2020.
 
• It contributed** 63 percent **of FCI’s total paddy procurement across the country.
 
• Telangana supplied over **52.23 lakh tonnes** of paddy against the nationwide procurement of 83.01 lakh tonnes.
 
• Andhra Pradesh contributed only **23.04 lakh tonnes** in the same season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Paddy procurement in 2021-2022 (top 3 states)- 
 
 
• Punjab - 186.86 lakh tonnes
 
• Chhattisgarh - 92.01 lakh tonnes
 
• Telangana - 70.22 lakh tonnes.
